CarrierRef.description:
What a placement sits on (doc 12 §2.3 `CarrierRef`): `{"carrier": id}` or `{"surface": id}`. Piggy-back
mounting on another placement (1.0) is kept verbatim as [`CarrierRef::Unknown`].

Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

PartRef.description: A part on a device (doc 03 §7): the embedded copy and an optional part variant (FR-PRT-003).

copy.description: The copy ID of the embedded part, `v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`.

variant.description: A variant key of the part.

Pose3.description: A pose (doc 05 §3.2): translation t = [x, y, z] in nanometres and rotation q = [w, x, y, z], a unit quaternion in 10^-9. JSON Schema cannot express that q is unit (within 2.001 x 10^9 of 10^18 squared) and sign-normalised (w > 0, or the first non-zero component positive); the reader rejects both.

description:
A placement (doc 03 §16 `Placement3D`, doc 12 §2.3, rank 54, the layout file of its carrier's space): a device,
or one of its functions, on a carrier at a pose relative to the carrier.

It stores no tag text (labels are `layout_label(placement)`, D-02) and no geometry: the footprint comes from the
part. A placement cannot outlive its device (delete policy cascade, EW-LAY-002) and keeps its carrier (forbid).

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

carrier.description: The carrier or surface it sits on (delete policy forbid).

function.description: One function placed on its own (a door handle); absent: the whole device (delete policy cascade).

locked.description: Excluded from push, swap and auto-fill (FR-LAY-006).

part.description:
The part use of the device this placement realises; absent: the primary mountable part. `layout.place`
always writes it (WP-S4.01 D6); no delete policy: a placement whose part use left the device is reported
by EW-LAY-003, never changed silently.

pose.description:
The pose relative to the carrier: on a rail `t = (s, 0, 0)` with `q` identity or 180° about `w`; on a
surface `t = (u, v, 0)` rotated by k·90° about `w` (WP-S4.01 D5).
